name: Breadth-First Flood
summary: Scan for an unvisited land cell, then flood its island with a queue (breadth-first), counting cells as they leave the queue. Track the largest island area.
visualizationIntent: init: build a visited-state grid; water cells dim. loop: scan for a land cell; when found, seed a queue and flood outward. update: each dequeued cell becomes current, is counted, and its land neighbours join the frontier queue. check: after each island, compare its area to the best. return: the largest island area.
